lyrics.ti:
[[chorus]]
ናይ ልበይ ኵሉ ንመን ክነግር
ብዘይብኣኺ ንመን ከማኽር
ናይ ድኹማት ሰብ መጸግዒት ኢኺ
ሓዘን ጭንቀተይ ተርሕቕለይ’ኺ
[[/chorus]]

[[highlight]]ቅዱሳን ኣበው መሪጾምኺ /2/[[/highlight]]
ስለ ዝወጹ ካብ ሲኦል ሓዊ
[[highlight]]ክድሕን እየ ድንግል በኣኺ /2/[[/highlight]]

ኣድሕንኒ’ለ ምስ ጸዋዕኩኺ
[[highlight]]ፈታሒት ሽግረይ ኣኽሊለይ ኢኺ /2/[[/highlight]]
ኣይቅየምን’ዩ ለዋህ ልብኺ
[[highlight]]ቅድሚ ስእልኺ ክሰግድ እየ /2/[[/highlight]]
ኣደ ጐይታየይ ክዝምረልኪ’የ

[[highlight]]ዋሕሰይ ኢኺ ድንግል ኣደይ /2/[[/highlight]]
ስምኪ ዝፈለጥኩ ብህፃንነተይ
[[highlight]]ኵሉ ጊዜ ንዓይ ጽቡቕ ጌርክለይ /2/[[/highlight]]
እንታይ እሞ ክብለኪ ቃላት ዘይብለይ

[[highlight]]ኣብ ጊዜ ድኻመይ ምርኩሰይ ኢኺ /2/[[/highlight]]
ዝደገፍክኒ ብቅልጡፍ መጺኺ
[[highlight]]ስምኪ ንኃጥእ ዝቕድስ እዩ /2/[[/highlight]]
ካብ ሞት ናብ ሕይወት ዝልውጥ እዩ
lyrics.ti_ro:
[[chorus]]
Nay libey kulu nimen kinegr
Bizeybiʾakhi nimen kemakhr
Nay dikhumat seb metsegʿit ʾikhi
Hazen ch'inqetey terhiqhley’khi
[[/chorus]]

[[highlight]]Qidusan ʾabew meritsomkhi /2/[[/highlight]]
Sile ziwetsu kab siʾol hawi
[[highlight]]Kidhin ʾiye dingil beʾakhi /2/[[/highlight]]

ʾAdhinni’le mis tsewaʿikukhi
[[highlight]]Fetahit shigrey ʾakhliley ʾikhi /2/[[/highlight]]
ʾAyqiyemn’yu lewah libkhi
[[highlight]]Qidmi siʾilkhi kisegd ʾiye /2/[[/highlight]]
ʾAde goytayey kizmirelki’ye

[[highlight]]Wahsey ʾikhi dingil ʾadey /2/[[/highlight]]
Simki zifelet'ku bihtsannetey
[[highlight]]Kulu gize niʿay tsibuqh gerkiley /2/[[/highlight]]
ʾIntay ʾimo kibleki qalat zeybiley

[[highlight]]ʾAb gize dikhamey mirkusey ʾikhi /2/[[/highlight]]
Zidegefkini biqlit'uf metsikhi
[[highlight]]Simki nihat'ʾi ziqhdis ʾiyu /2/[[/highlight]]
Kab mot nab hiywet zilwit' ʾiyu
